name: kiro-remote-ssh
description: Open a folder on a remote Linux host over SSH, with the editor, terminal and agent running on that host.

kiroRemoteSsh.sshPath.description: Absolute path to the ssh executable. Leave empty to resolve it from PATH. Only OpenSSH is supported.

kiroRemoteSsh.connectTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for a connection to be established.

kiroRemoteSsh.serverDownloadUrlTemplate.description: Overrides the server download URL template. Read from application scope only, never from a workspace, so that a repository cannot redirect where the server comes from. Leave empty to use the value the installed application publishes.

kiroRemoteSsh.serverDigests.description: SHA-256 digests pinned per server commit, as commit to digest. A pin here overrides the digest recorded on first use. Read from application scope only.

kiroRemoteSsh.logLevel.description: Log verbosity. No level logs connection tokens or composed command lines.
